title: Draw shapes and connect them
done: That is it: drag on the board to draw; the agent reads each shape and its text.

steps.caption: The board is shared: you and the agent both draw on it, and the agent reads it as plain text.
Choose a shape from the toolbar, then drag on the board to draw it. Double-click it to give it text.
Here a shape is added below the reader, and joined to the parser.
To connect two shapes, draw an arrow from one to the other. It stays attached when they move.
Your turn: choose the rectangle tool, then drag on the board to draw one.
